description: url(#id) references of mask, clip-path and filter to an inline SVG: mask units and types, clip units and rules, filter primitives and regions, in a list, missing ones

florui.css: .wrap { position: relative; width: 540px; height: 380px; background-color: #ffffff; } .b { position: absolute; width: 100px; height: 50px; box-sizing: border-box; border: 4px solid #2a3a58; } .p0 { left: 20px; top: 20px; background-color: #d05040; mask: url(#m1); } .p1 { left: 150px; top: 20px; background-color: #40a060; mask: url(#m2); } .p2 { left: 280px; top: 20px; background-color: #4070d0; mask: url(#m3); } .p3 { left: 410px; top: 20px; background-color: #e0b030; mask: url(#nope); } .p4 { left: 20px; top: 110px; background-color: #a050c0; clip-path: url(#c1); } .p5 { left: 150px; top: 110px; background-color: #30a0b0; clip-path: url(#c2); } .p6 { left: 280px; top: 110px; background-color: #d05040; clip-path: url(#c3); } .p7 { left: 410px; top: 110px; background-color: #40a060; clip-path: url(#nope); } .p8 { left: 20px; top: 200px; background-color: #4070d0; filter: url(#f1); } .p9 { left: 150px; top: 200px; background-color: #e0b030; filter: url(#f2); } .p10 { left: 280px; top: 200px; background-color: #a050c0; filter: url(#f3); } .p11 { left: 410px; top: 200px; background-color: #30a0b0; filter: url(#f4); } .p12 { left: 20px; top: 290px; background-color: #d05040; filter: invert(1) url(#f1); } .p13 { left: 150px; top: 290px; background-color: #40a060; filter: url(#f6); } .p14 { left: 280px; top: 290px; background-color: #4070d0; filter: url(#nope); } .p15 { left: 410px; top: 290px; background-color: #e0b030; clip-path: url(#c1); transform: rotate(10deg); opacity: 0.7; }

classification.reason: Measured against Chromium 153 on Windows: 0.11% of the pixels differ by more than 8 levels of a channel and every box has the same bounding box. What is left is the antialiasing along the edge of a circular clip and the Gaussian blur, which the SVG renderer approximates. It covers url(#id) of mask (user-space and box units, luminance and alpha, a missing one hiding the box), of clip-path (units, clip-rule, a missing one clipping nothing) and of filter (primitives, default and user-space regions, in a list after a native function, a missing one filtering nothing). With the references ignored the same fixture measures 22.41%, so it fails.
